subject.title: [regression] Bundled MCP config tempDir race still present on openclaw@2026.5.20 (#73244 reopened?)

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main repro before changing the claude-cli bundled MCP cleanup owner again, or is the current source divergence from v2026.6.11 enough to authorize a focused fix?
rationale: The report is credible and current source has a clear stale-tempDir failure shape, but the cleanup owner changed after the shipped fix and this lifecycle area has leak and availability tradeoffs.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main/latest-package proof around a resume or fingerprint-restart spawn, then patch the exact owner path.

options.title: Authorize source-level fix
options.body: Allow a narrow repair to restore live-session ownership of the bundled MCP cleanup and add regression tests without waiting for a live repro.

options.title: Split diagnostics follow-up
options.body: Track the generic user-facing error copy separately so the tempDir lifecycle fix stays focused.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main/latest-package proof around a resume or fingerprint-restart spawn, then patch the exact owner path.

likelyOwner.reason: He landed the original cleanup-transfer fix and has the strongest history on this exact lifecycle decision.
